user.title: SMSTunnel
user.description: Send SMS through your own Android phone. You need an API key with the sms:send permission, created in your SMSTunnel dashboard.

reconfigure.title: SMSTunnel settings
reconfigure.description: Change who receives the texts, the phone that sends them, or the API key. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one. If you change the server URL, type the key again.

data.api_key: API key (leave empty to keep the current one)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SMSTunnel server. Check the server URL and your network.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that it is correct and has the sms:send permission.
error.no_recipients: Enter at least one phone number.
error.already_configured: Another SMSTunnel entry already uses this server and first recipient.
error.key_required_for_new_server: You changed the server URL, so type the API key again. The saved key is never sent to a different server.

abort.already_configured: This SMSTunnel account is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The settings were saved. The notify action uses them from now on.
abort.entry_not_found: This SMSTunnel entry no longer exists.
abort.single_entry_only: SMSTunnel is added more than once here. All its entries share the one action notify.smstunnel and only one of them answers it, so the settings can be changed from this menu only when a single entry is left. Remove the extra entries first.
